params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Zed}} basic attacks against targets {{as|below half health}} will deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to a portion of {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: This effect cannot recur on the same {{tip|champion}} for a period.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zed's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against targets {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|5 to 10 for 3|1;7;17}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} as {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.description2: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Contempt for the Weak'' deals 75% damage and is capped at 175.
params.description3: ''Contempt for the Weak'' cannot occur on the same {{tip|champion}} more than once every few seconds.
params.notes:
* The enhanced attack applies other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the bonus damage cannot).
* ''Contempt for the Weak'' is not consumed when {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blind|missed}}, but it is consumed when {{tip|blocked}}.
* ''Contempt for the Weak'' considers the target's health upon landing the attack, not when it's declared.
** If the target falls below the threshold while '''Zed''' is winding up the attack, ''Contempt for the Weak'' applies, and vice versa.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 60% against targets beyond the first.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.6 to 240*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Shurikens'' blocked by {{tip|spell shield}} still count as being hit for the reduced pass-through damage.
* ''Razor Shuriken'' is special cased to not lock out {{ais|Living Shadow 2|Zed|Living Shadow}} recast during its cast time.
** Other abilities are locked out and buffered to cast after ''Razor Shuriken's'' cast time, as normal.
* If '''Zed''' buffers an attack command during ''Razor Shuriken's'' cast time the attack will perform slower than if '''Zed''' had attacked after the cast time.
** The same does not happen if '''Zed''' recasts {{ai|Living Shadow 2|Zed|Living Shadow}} during ''Razor Shuriken's'' cast time.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Zed''' restores {{sti|{{as|energy}}}} whenever he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' or multiple ''Shadows'' hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' creates a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' that dashes to the target location and remains there for {{fd|5.25}} seconds, being able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range. ''Living Shadow'' can be recast while within range of the ''Shadow''.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Shadow Swap:}} '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' {{tip|blink}} to swap places.
params.description4: ''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''
params.target range: {{tt|325 - 650|Minimum and maximum shadow placement range (minimum range estimated)}}
params.outofrange: Target at maximum range (first cast clamped)
params.notes:
* '''Zed''' gains a buff for {{fd|5.25}} seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast ''Living Shadow''.
** The buff is granted briefly after ''Living Shadow'' is cast.
*** If cast at minimum distance, the buff and the ''Shadow's'' individual durations will effectively start at the same time.
*** If cast at greater than the minimum distance, then the buff's duration will start before the ''Shadow's'' duration.
* The passive is available while the ability has not been learned. It will grant the {{sti|energy}} refund strength at rank 1.
* The {{sti|energy}} refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}.
* ''Living Shadow's'' recast can be queued to cast while the ''Shadow'' is dashing; the recast will occur once it has been placed.
* ''Living Shadow'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* If ''Living Shadow'' is recast during {{ais|Q|Zed}} cast, '''Zed''' will instantly release the shuriken from the cast location of {{ai|Q|Zed}} while still remaining in cast time. Once he has swapped places, he will then throw the shuriken that the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' would have thrown instead.
** '''Zed''' will cast {{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}} as he normally would from the new location, but over the remaining cast time and towards the same point of cast.
** The [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' will not throw a shuriken from its new location, but will continue to play the cast animation for {{ai|Q|Zed}}.
** This special interaction does not occur with the swap recast of {{ai|Death Mark 2|Zed|Death Mark}}; the recast will be buffered if used during {{ais|Q|Zed}} cast.
* '''Zed''' will swap places with the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' by all means if he buffers ''Living Shadow's'' recast during its dash.{{bug|2}}
** ''Living Shadow'' cannot be recast while '''Zed''' is marking his target with {{ai|R|Zed}}, but may still be recast if it was buffered.{{bug|1}}
* If '''Zed''' casts ''Living Shadow'' while a non-''{{ai|Death Mark 2|Zed|Death Mark}} Shadow'' is already present, the previous ''Shadow'' will instantly disappear.
* If a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' expires while in the cast time of {{ai|Q|Zed}}, the mimicked cast will be cancelled.
* [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will cast {{ai|E|Zed}} independently of being in {{ais|Q|Zed}} cast time or not.{{bug|2}}
* [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' spawned from ''Living Shadow'' may sometimes last for up to an additional {{fd|0.25}} seconds.{{bug}}
* [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will not disappear when '''Zed''' dies.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zed}} slashes to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies hit. Enemies hit by a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border]] ''Shadow's'' slash are also briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.blurb3: ''{{ai|Living Shadow|Zed|Living Shadow's}}'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by '''Zed's''' slash.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' slashes to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: Enemies hit by a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow's'' slash are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, with {{tt|multiple slashes|See notes}} dealing no additional damage but the slow's effectiveness being increased by 50%.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Living Shadow|Zed|Living Shadow's}}'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by '''Zed's''' slash.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|315|Slash radius from Zed}}|{{tt|290|Slash radius from Shadows}}}}
params.notes:
* An enemy counts as being hit by ''multiple'' slashes at once when they are hit by a ''Shadow Slash'' from '''Zed''' and at least one of his ''Shadows'', or two of his ''Shadows''. In any case, a target can only be damaged by one slash per cast of ''Shadow Slash''.
** The enhanced slow strength is applied as long as the enemy is hit by at least two slashes, even if '''Zed's''' slash is one of them despite him not being able to apply the base slow himself.
*** Slashes beyond the second have no additional effect on the target; a third slash against an enemy does not deal damage nor increase the slow's strength (slow effectiveness is capped at 150% of the base strength).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block one ''Shadow Slash'' even if multiple of them hit at the same time, prioritizing blocking the slash from '''Zed's''' [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow''.
** The damage from at least one slash will always be blocked but still counts for preventing other slashes from applying the damage (other slashes are considered to be ''additional'' slashes which are not eligible for dealing the damage).
** The slow will be blocked if hit by '''Zed's''' slash and a ''Shadow's'' slash, due to the latter slash being blocked.
** The slow will be applied at base strength if hit by the slashes of two ''Shadows'', due to at least one slash from a ''Shadow'' successfully hitting the target with the other slash being blocked (thus preventing the slow from being enhanced).
** The slow will be applied at enhanced strength if hit by the slashes of '''Zed''' and two of his ''Shadows'', due at least two of the slashes successfully hitting the target (in this case, the slashes from '''Zed''' and one of the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'').
* ''Shadow Slash'' does not interrupt attack, movement, or cast commands.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zed''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and, after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, he {{tip|dashes}} to 125 units beyond the target enemy champion from his position at the end of the delay over {{fd|0.35}} seconds. Afterwards, he becomes targetable again, renders the target ''Marked for Death'' for 3 seconds, and gains {{tip|ghost|ghosting}} for the same duration.
params.description2: '''Zed''' also spawns a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' at his casting position for 9 seconds which is able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range. ''Death Mark'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his reappearance while the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is active, though not in the last {{fd|1.25}} seconds of its duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Marked for Death:}} '''Zed''' stores a portion of all {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}} he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' deal to the target, detonating at the end of the duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Shadow Swap:}} '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' {{tip|blink}} to swap places.
params.description5: ''If the target dies or is 1950 or more units away before the dash begins, Death Mark is cancelled, causing the ability to go on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} cooldown, '''Zed''' to reappear at the cast location, and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Shadow he spawned to disappear.''
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target unit to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
* '''Zed''' gains a buff for {{fd|7.5}} seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast ''Death Mark''.
** The buff is granted on-cast and lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after it expires.
* The [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is spawned the moment ''Death Mark'' is cast.
* '''Zed''' will track the target if they change locations.
** He will dash through the target's previous location while still applying the {{as|mark|buzzword}} if they are 2200 or more units away.
* '''Zed''' will become targetable, apply the {{as|mark|buzzword}}, and gain the {{tip|ghosting}} as soon as his dash ends.
** The {{as|mark|buzzword}} will not be applied to the target if they are {{tip|untargetable}} by the time '''Zed's''' dash ends.
* '''Zed''' will be ordered to basic attack his target after reappearing.
* ''Death Mark's'' stored damage derives from all [[basic attack]]s, [[Champion ability|abilities]], [[item]]s, [[Runes Reforged|runes]] and [[buff]]s.
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* While not being a damage mitigation, ''Death Mark'' does not store {{tip|true damage}}. [https://youtu.be/DGLC3oMoQMo] {{bug|2}}.|affectedEffects=Zed R|estimatedPatchOrigin=V1.0.0.151|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1785906669|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Zed/Death Mark
}}
* ''Death Mark's'' [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' is functionally the same as a regular one, but it lasts longer and can be swapped to regardless of range.
** The range at which it mimics '''Zed's''' abilities does not change.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the {{as|mark's|buzzword}} application. They will not prevent '''Zed''' from initiating ''Death Mark'' against the target nor block the detonation from a {{as|mark|buzzword}} that is already applied.
* If '''Zed''' dies during ''Death Mark'', the ability will cancel instantly and he will reappear at his current location. The cooldown is not refunded.
** If he enters {{tip|resurrection}} before the dash, ''Death Mark'' does not cancel. If he enters it while dashing, the dash is interrupted.
* If the {{tip|dash}} is interrupted, '''Zed''' stops, places himself to the ground (ends all displacements affecting him, but does not remove {{tip|airborne}} effects), and reappears prematurely at his current location. The {{as|mark|buzzword}} will still be applied regardless.
** '''Zed''' will remove {{tip|airborne}} effects from himself immediately upon starting the dash.
* Once '''Zed''' begins the {{tip|dash}}, two [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will also appear to be dashing through his target, each one spawning a certain distance behind the target (from the right and left). These ''shadows'' do '''not''' mimic abilities and disappear immediately after they stop dashing but they grant {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings.
** These ''shadows'' have a tracking distance of 2200 and a dash speed of 1750.
* ''Death Mark'' does not cancel if the target enters a {{tip|zombie state}} before the dash begins.
* If the {{as|mark's|buzzword}} {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} is higher than the target's '''current''' health, a ''spinning shuriken'' will appear above the victim. This does not necessarily mean the target will die, as it does not consider {{tip|shield|shields}} or forms of [[damage modifier]]s that are not respected by this predictive calculation.
